scientific_integrity: Finite exhaustiveness is established by canonical reversible feedback states and a separately checked Euler-tour construction; both invariant evaluations are independently implemented. No independence or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for binary order-five de Bruijn cycles modulo rotation with maximum absolute nonzero *periodic* autocorrelation; not a theorem for higher orders, not aperiodic correlation or system-level security/performance. title: Exact joint linear-complexity and periodic-sidelobe spectrum of binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
